statusRule: Endpoint reachability is PROBE_GREEN only. A layer is not counted fixed until the exact product contract and real browser map path are proven. Source failure must never be rendered as zero/no records. CI evidence must execute the sandbox branch exact head, not an implicit pull-request merge ref.

currentSandboxCandidate.note: This status write advances the branch head. Re-resolve PR #72 and require exact-head source probes, regression, local desktop/mobile browser proof, exact Cloudflare deployment and deployed desktop/mobile browser proof before acceptance or prototype-pointer promotion.

qaLineage.reason: Prior pull_request jobs checked out GitHub's generated merge ref despite the step label saying exact SHA. The workflow now explicitly checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha or github.sha.

timeEngine.next: Extend the same semantic time-axis contract to other temporal sources only after their base map contracts are solid.

emodnet-dissolved-oxygen-climatology.truthBoundary: Monthly climatology is a long-term seasonal condition pattern, not a live oxygen reading or proof of hypoxia.

nasa-eonet.truthBoundary: Provider-reported open natural events are not automatically local alerts or ecological-impact determinations.

climate-trace.truthBoundary: Climate TRACE source records are emitting assets with reported/estimated emissions, not live plumes and not proof of legal liability.
